objective: Confirm that a long-observation, tokenizer-free-signal version of the retry-vs-migrate soft boundary lets Qwen3.5-4B climb from base < SFT < SFT+GRPO, and that the SFT+GRPO endpoint reaches or exceeds Qwen3.5-35B-A3B base on the same case set.

sft_4b.training: LoRA SFT on planner_retry_migrate_v7_longobs sft_train, select on sft_dev

sft_grpo_4b.training: LoRA GRPO on top of sft_4b using grpo_train step-2 prompts, three seeds 42/43/44

sft_gate_on_grpo_dev.condition: sft_4b.action_match_rate - base_4b.action_match_rate >= 0.15 AND paired 95% CI excludes 0
sft_gate_on_grpo_dev.on_fail: abort study, do not run GRPO

grpo_support_gate_on_grpo_dev.condition: nonzero_reward_variance_rate >= 0.15 on 4 samples per prompt (v6 had 0.011 and GRPO was skipped)

grpo_effect_gate_on_grpo_dev.condition: for all three seeds, sft_grpo_4b - sft_4b paired 95% CI on action_match_rate excludes 0 AND wrong_side_effecting_actions_mean(sft_grpo_4b) <= wrong_side_effecting_actions_mean(sft_4b)
grpo_effect_gate_on_grpo_dev.on_fail: reject GRPO promotion, publish SFT-only comparison; sealed test stays closed

cross_model_gate_on_grpo_dev.condition: sft_grpo_4b.mean_rule_reward - base_35b.mean_rule_reward paired 95% CI lower bound >= 0
cross_model_gate_on_grpo_dev.on_fail: publish result with explicit caveat that 4B SFT+GRPO does not meet 35B base

sealed_test_gate.action_on_pass: open sealed test exactly once, evaluate the preselected sft_grpo_4b seed-42 checkpoint

target_outcomes.narrative: base_4b < sft_4b < sft_grpo_4b (each transition CI-significant), AND sft_grpo_4b >= base_35b
target_outcomes.notes: 35B base is untrained on the routing rule set; it does in-context inference over the long observation. 4B SFT+GRPO is expected to internalise the rules and exceed 35B base without training the 35B model (training 35B is infeasible on 4xH20).

risks_and_mitigations.risk: SFT saturates on grpo_dev (repeat of v6 pathology)
risks_and_mitigations.mitigation: 8 scenarios expand the discriminative surface; long observations force information integration; if still saturated, expand P5/P6 with more challenging sub-templates

risks_and_mitigations.detection: MI(badge, target) and MI(detector, target) already 0 in the manifest; also monitor per-scenario pass rate parity

risks_and_mitigations.risk: GRPO increases wrong-side-effecting actions like v6-Seed44 did
35B base overshoots SFT+GRPO 4B on some scenarios via in-context reasoning
risks_and_mitigations.detection: cross_model_gate is a hard gate; if failed, publish caveat and design v8 with harder trace-length / multi-hop scenarios

sealed_test_commitment: The 480-case test split is not opened until all preregistered gates pass on grpo_dev. Only the seed-42 sft_grpo_4b checkpoint is eligible for the sealed run. One-shot: repeated eval of the same checkpoint on test is disallowed after the first read.
